alignment.algorithm: Convert RSS sampledAt and footprint start_time.date to UTC; match footprint samples to nearest RSS timestamp.

blankWindow.selection: First 11 explicit blank samples by array order, not phase label.

alignment.phaseLabelGap: Two later RSS samples (elapsed 1220/1334 ms) remain tagged about-blank-baseline after this explicit window; excluded from baseline.

footprint.unit: MiB; top-level total footprint. Per-PID values overlap slightly.
footprint.rssPeakRelation: RSS peak is audio-09 decode-and-waveform at 10:40:22.874Z, 153 ms after footprint peak; the 0.5 s footprint sampling missed the short peak.

supported: RSS peak growth is renderer-dominated; GPU RSS is below blank baseline.
The bounded 11-load stable RSS trend is positive; renderer grows while GPU RSS is flat.
Top-level footprint rises about 400.8 MiB from timestamp-matched blank and includes GPU cost; footprint GPU share also rises blank-to-peak.
notEstablished: Process totals do not identify retained JS objects or prove a leak.
RSS/footprint cannot separate decoded PCM, decoder/Web Audio allocations, allocator retention, or other page resources.
Budget pass/fail is not assessed: the budget is not explicitly RSS-specific and the metrics are not interchangeable.
